item.blurb: CureMeAbroad Raises $1.1M Pre-seed. CureMeAbroad raises $1.1M in pre-seed funding led by SteerX Ventures to scale its AI-powered platform for cross-border healthcare discovery and booking.
Ocular AI Raises $2M Pre-seed. Ocular AI raises $2M pre-seed round led by Drive Capital to advance its AI training data platform and voice-native model benchmarking.
Comparables.ai Raises $6M Seed. Comparables.ai raises $6M in seed funding led by Pragmatech and Araya Ventures to scale its AI-powered market intelligence platform for dealmakers.
SafeWorld Raises $12.2M Seed. SafeWorld raises $12.2M seed round led by Shine Capital and a16z Speedrun to advance its AI-powered robot safety simulation platform.
UpSmith Raises $10M Series A. UpSmith raises $10 million Series A led by SemperVirens to expand its AI platform for home services contractors across the United States.
Zari Company Raises $11M Series A. Zari Company raises $11M in Series A funding led by Korea Investment Partners to scale its rental management and resident review platform, Zaritalk.
Supabase Raises $150M in Funding. Supabase raises $150M in growth capital led by GIC to accelerate its agentic infrastructure and database platform for AI developers.
